record.scope: The three units in appliesTo declare AQUA_STEP: Quaxly (1 star), Quaxwell (2 stars) and Quaquaval (3 stars); all have range 1 and maxPP 100 and no passive. The strategy is shared; unit differences are the star count (table index).
record.summary: The strategy computes a reference coordinate one sign-step from the caster toward the cast target (caster.x + sign(dx), caster.y + sign(dy)), asks board.getClosestAvailablePlace for the free cell closest (Manhattan) to that reference anywhere on the board, and requests a non-forced moveTo there. Because the search covers ALL free cells, the movement is not limited to one cell: it is the free cell nearest the reference, which can be far away on a crowded board (probe: caster (0,0), target (1,0), only free cell (7,5) -> move requested to (7,5)). With no free cell no move is requested. In every case a DelayedCommand with nominal delay 300 is queued; when it runs it requests SPECIAL damage on the cast target (raw 25/50/100/200 by stars) and adds speed to the caster (raw 10/15/20/25 by stars; AP-scaled). The 300 is a nominal delay consumed by update(dt) (the command runs on the first update that takes the delay below 0), not a guaranteed execution time.

targeting.who: the cast target (damage); caster itself (step and speed gain)
targeting.note: The reference coordinate uses the cast target's position at cast time; the delayed damage uses the target entity (its position is read again for the broadcast only). The damage and speed command is queued whether or not a destination cell was found.

geometry.shape: destination = the free cell closest (Manhattan) to (caster.x + sign(dx), caster.y + sign(dy)) among ALL free cells of the board (not limited to one cell); single-target damage afterwards

effects.target: cast target (after a nominal delay of 300)
effects.scaling: requested = table value. applied by handleSpecialDamage: damage x (1 + AP/100) (apBoost true by default); x critPower (adjusted by target items) if the cast crit.
effects.resolution: after the delay, PokemonState.handleDamage computes an intermediate value damage / (1 + ARMOR_FACTOR x SPE_DEF), rounded up with a minimum of 1, and the shield absorbs before HP; this is not guaranteed final HP damage. protect / skydiving / magicBounce on the target at the time the command fires block the hit entirely. takenDamage includes shield damage. The command is queued even when no destination cell exists. Probe: the queued command has delay 300, has not run after update(300) and has run after a further update(1) (damage 25 SPECIAL requested, speed gain 10 with apBoost 1); this shows the delay is consumed by update(dt), not that 300 is a guaranteed timing.

effects.scaling: requested = table value. applied by addSpeed: Big Eater Belt x1.25 rounded down for a holder; then x(1 + AP/100) with apBoost 1, x critPower if the cast crit (no rounding); then speed = clamp(speed + value, 0, MAX_SPEED = 300).
effects.resolution: requested (table) -> applied (after belt, AP, crit) -> actual change (after the 0..300 clamp). No timer or removal in this file.

declaredRaw.description: non-forced moveTo to the free cell closest to the one-sign-step reference coordinate; not limited to one cell

effects.resolution: moveTo(x, y, board, false) when getClosestAvailablePlace returns a cell: swap with that empty cell, cooldown set to 100. getClosestAvailablePlace sorts every free cell by Manhattan distance to the reference coordinate (first in scan order on ties), so the cell can be anywhere on the board. Probe: caster (0,0), target (1,0), only free cell (7,5) -> move requested to (7,5); no free cell -> no move.

starBehavior.note: both tables are indexed by the casting entity's stars; the 4-star values (200 damage, +25 speed) are not reachable at the bare factory star counts of these units. Whether other mechanics change an entity's star count was not examined.

record.positionalConditions: The step needs a free cell somewhere on the board; with none, the caster stays (the delayed command is still queued). A target already adjacent still triggers a move request toward the free cell closest to the sign-step reference, which may be far from the caster when nearby cells are occupied.
record.repeatedCastsAndModes: No stored state or modes. Each cast queues its own delayed command, and the speed gain stacks additively across casts (up to MAX_SPEED).
record.rawVsResolved: Declared raw: damage 25/50/100 and speed +10/15/20 (1/2/3 stars). Damage after the delay = requested x (1 + AP/100) (x crit factor), then an intermediate SPE_DEF division, minimum 1 (not guaranteed final HP damage); shield damage is included in takenDamage. Speed applied = floor(raw x 1.25) with a Big Eater Belt, then x (1 + AP/100) x crit factor, then clamped to 0..300. The 300 delay is nominal, not a guaranteed execution time.
dependsOnUnverifiedGenericCombat: Final damage after later modifiers in handleDamage (shields, items, resurrection, field multipliers); only the SPE_DEF division and the minimum of 1 were read
When the cast fires in a real fight (PP gain, targeting, silence) - only the pp >= maxPP && canCast gate was read
Crit resolution - only the ABILITY_CRIT / canCritByDefault gate was located
unresolved: Whether the delayed command still runs (and whether the damage and speed gain still apply) if the caster dies or the simulation ends before 300 ms: the removal of a dead entity's commands was not traced
Whether the damage call is skipped or redirected if the target has died or moved by the time the command fires (the code calls handleSpecialDamage on the stored target entity unconditionally)
Tie order among equally close empty cells depends on board.forEach order and the stability of Array.prototype.sort (not verified beyond reading)
Whether the three units ever reach a different star count than the factory value
No routing uncertainties were queued for this record
No gameplay evidence; candidate is source reading plus mechanical checks only

The nominal delay 300 is consumed by update(dt) of the entity's commands; how often and when the simulation calls update (and whether a dead or removed entity's commands still run) was not traced, so no execution time is claimed
